gold: Primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue

selector.rationale: Hidradenocarcinoma best explains the findings due to its characteristic dermal tumor infiltration, Indian file pattern, and positivity for pancytokeratin, cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies.

rejected.why: Lack of epidermal involvement and specific apocrine gland association

support_spans: Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement. Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles and lined up in an 'Indian file pattern' with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm.
Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies.
Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
